items.source: name - the identifier.
items.translation: name - 标识符。

items.source: SqlIdentifier renders its name using IdentifierProcessing rules. Use getReference() to refer to an object using the identifier when e.g. obtaining values from a result or providing values for a prepared statement. toSql(IdentifierProcessing) renders the identifier for SQL statement usage.
items.translation: SqlIdentifier 使用 IdentifierProcessing 规则来渲染其名称。请使用 getReference() 在例如从结果中获取值或为预编译语句提供值时，通过标识符引用对象。toSql(IdentifierProcessing) 则用于渲染 SQL 语句中的标识符。

items.source: SqlIdentifier are composable so an identifier may consist of a single identifier part or can be composed from multiple parts. Composed identifier can be traversed with Streamable.stream() or Iterable.iterator(). The iteration order depends on the actual composition ordering.
items.translation: `SqlIdentifier` 是可组合的，因此标识符可以仅由单个标识符部分组成，也可以由多个部分组合而成。组合后的标识符可以通过 Streamable.stream() 或 Iterable.iterator() 进行遍历。遍历顺序取决于实际的组合顺序。

items.source: SqlIdentifier objects are immutable. Calling transformational methods such as transform(UnaryOperator) creates a new instance.
items.translation: `SqlIdentifier` 对象是不可变的。调用转换方法（如 transform(UnaryOperator)）会创建一个新的实例。

Use this method when rendering an identifier in SQL statements as in: 
select yourColumn from someTable
IdentifierProcessing rules are applied to the identifier.
items.translation:
在渲染 SQL 语句中的标识符时使用此方法，例如： 
select yourColumn from someTable
IdentifierProcessing 规则将应用于该标识符。

items.source: Represents a named object that exists in the database like a table name or a column name. SQL identifiers are created from a name with specifying whether the name should be quoted or unquoted.
items.translation: 表示数据库中存在的命名对象，例如表名或列名。SQL 标识符是通过指定名称是否应加引号或未加引号的 name 创建的。
